title: Results recap
idea: Results recap: A meaningful outcome and causal recap precede next-run action
audience: People who need to review run within a game surface.
worksWellWhen: Players learn from route and resource decisions
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic editorial layout through its review run priority and explicit commitment contract: Results derive from actual completed run state
navigation: Results recap keeps the current review run context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A meaningful outcome and causal recap precede next-run action
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review run; players learn from route and resource decisions
composition.priority: Results derive from actual completed run state

imagery.role: Support the actual review run context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep next action separate from scrollable detailed statistics
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the results recap structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review run content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Results derive from actual completed run state
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review run content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Results derive from actual completed run state
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review run context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
